moments.title: Premier League Sunday action
moments.blurb: Today, Sunday, September 20, sees four Premier League matches, including Manchester City vs Sunderland and Fulham vs Manchester United.

angles.name: Matchday Buzz
angles.copy: Sunday Funday! Premier League action continues today with Man City taking on Sunderland, and Man Utd facing Fulham. Who are you backing?

angles.name: United Focus
angles.copy: Fulham vs Manchester United later today! Can the Red Devils bounce back from recent form? Tune in and let us know your predictions.

moments.title: Arsenal's first Premier League defeat
moments.blurb: Defending champions Arsenal suffered their first Premier League loss of the 2026-27 season yesterday, falling 3-0 to Brighton & Hove Albion.

angles.name: Shock Result
angles.copy: Well, that was unexpected! Brighton handed Arsenal their first Premier League defeat of the season yesterday with a convincing 3-0 win. Did you see it coming?

angles.name: Title Race Impact
angles.copy: The Premier League title race just got a lot more interesting! Arsenal's unbeaten run is over after a 3-0 loss to Brighton. How big a statement was that?

moments.title: Championship Sunday games
moments.blurb: The EFL Championship has two fixtures today, Sunday, September 20: Wolves vs West Brom and Norwich vs Bolton.

angles.name: Championship Action
angles.copy: It's Championship Sunday! Wolves take on West Brom and Norwich face Bolton today. Who are you rooting for in the second tier?

angles.name: Midlands Derby
angles.copy: A big one in the Championship today: Wolves vs West Brom! Local bragging rights are on the line. Predict the score!

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing 2026 launched!
moments.blurb: The 2026 series of Strictly Come Dancing launched yesterday, Saturday, September 19, at 7:25 PM on BBC One, featuring new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly is Back!
angles.copy: Strictly Come Dancing 2026 officially launched last night! What did you think of the new hosts and the first celebrity pairings? Let us know!

angles.name: New Era for Strictly
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe & Johannes Radebe are shaking things up on Strictly! Did you catch the launch show? Who's your early favourite for the Glitterball?

moments.title: Bake Off returns with Nigella Lawson
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off Series 17 premieres Tuesday, September 22, at 8 PM on Channel 4, with Nigella Lawson joining as a new judge alongside Paul Hollywood.

angles.name: Bake Off is Back!
angles.copy: Get ready for soggy bottoms and showstoppers! The Great British Bake Off returns Tuesday with new judge Nigella Lawson. Will you be tuning in?

angles.name: Nigella in the Tent
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood in the Bake Off tent this Tuesday! What do you think she'll bring to the judging panel?

moments.title: Equinox Festival concludes today
moments.blurb: The grassroots music and arts festival, Equinox Festival, wraps up its 2026 edition today, Sunday, September 20, in Coningsby, Lincolnshire.

angles.name: Festival Finale
angles.copy: It's the final day of Equinox Festival in Lincolnshire! Hope everyone there is having an amazing time closing out the summer festival season!

angles.name: Last Chance Vibes
angles.copy: Catch the last of the magic at Equinox Festival today! What's been your favourite moment if you've been there?

moments.title: Sienna Spiro tops UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Sienna Spiro has earned her first UK number-one single with 'Great Expectation', becoming the youngest British female to reach the summit since Becky Hill in 2014.

angles.name: New Chart Topper
angles.copy: Huge congratulations to Sienna Spiro on landing her first UK Number 1 single with 'Great Expectation'! What a tune!

angles.name: Young Talent
angles.copy: Sienna Spiro is the youngest British female to hit Number 1 since 2014! 'Great Expectation' is officially the UK's top single. Have you heard it?

moments.title: Dolly Parton chart resurgence
moments.blurb: Following her recent passing, Dolly Parton has posthumously re-entered the UK Singles Chart with '9 To 5' at No. 9 and 'Jolene' at No. 27.

angles.name: Dolly's Legacy
angles.copy: A true legend. Dolly Parton's timeless hits '9 To 5' and 'Jolene' have re-entered the UK Singles Chart. Her music lives on!

angles.name: Chart Comeback
angles.copy: Incredible to see Dolly Parton back in the charts with '9 To 5' and 'Jolene'. Which of her classics is your all-time favourite?

moments.title: Autumnal Equinox this Wednesday
moments.blurb: The Autumnal Equinox, marking the start of astronomical autumn in the Northern Hemisphere, occurs on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, at 1:06 AM BST.

angles.name: Hello Autumn
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! Astronomical autumn officially begins this Wednesday, September 23rd, with the Autumnal Equinox. Time for cosy nights!

angles.name: Seasonal Shift
angles.copy: Longer nights and falling leaves are on their way! The Autumnal Equinox arrives this Wednesday. What's your favourite thing about autumn?

moments.title: Harvest Moon shines next Saturday
moments.blurb: The Harvest Moon, the full moon closest to the autumnal equinox, will be full on Saturday, September 26, 2026, at 5:49 PM BST.

angles.name: Moon Magic
angles.copy: Look up next Saturday! The stunning Harvest Moon will be full, lighting up the night sky. Perfect for a late-night stroll.

angles.name: September Skies
angles.copy: The Harvest Moon is traditionally a beautiful sight. Next Saturday, September 26th, catch the full moon at its best. Who's watching?

moments.title: Anastacia at Wembley Arena
moments.blurb: American singer Anastacia performs at London's OVO Arena Wembley on Saturday, September 26, 2026, as part of her #NTK Tour 2026.

angles.name: Anastacia Live
angles.copy: I'm Outta Love! Anastacia hits the OVO Arena Wembley next Saturday! Who's excited to see the pop icon live?

angles.name: Wembley Weekend
angles.copy: Next Saturday, Anastacia brings her #NTK Tour to Wembley! Get ready for a night of power ballads and pop anthems. Are you going?

moments.title: Loreen's 'Wildfire' UK Tour
moments.blurb: Double Eurovision winner Loreen is on her 'Wildfire Tour' in the UK this week, with dates in Glasgow (Sept 24), Manchester (Sept 25), and London (Sept 26).

angles.name: Loreen's UK Dates
angles.copy: Euphoria! Eurovision queen Loreen is bringing her 'Wildfire Tour' to Glasgow, Manchester & London this week. Who's got tickets?

angles.name: Glasgow Gig
angles.copy: Nation Radio Scotland! Loreen is live at Glasgow's O2 Academy this Thursday! Get ready for an unforgettable night.

moments.title: Judas Priest in London
moments.blurb: Heavy metal legends Judas Priest perform at the Eventim Apollo in London tomorrow, Monday, September 21, 2026.

angles.name: Metal Monday
angles.copy: Breaking the Law! Judas Priest are bringing the heavy metal thunder to London's Eventim Apollo tomorrow night. Who's ready to rock?

angles.name: London Rock
angles.copy: Don't miss Judas Priest live in London tomorrow! A legendary band in a legendary venue. Get your air guitars ready!

moments.title: Happy 78th to Styx's Chuck Panozzo
moments.blurb: Chuck Panozzo, co-founder and bassist of the legendary rock band Styx, turns 78 today, September 20.

angles.name: Styx Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 78th birthday to Chuck Panozzo, the iconic bassist and co-founder of Styx! What's your favourite Styx track?

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Rock and roll royalty! Happy Birthday to Chuck Panozzo of Styx, turning 78 today. Celebrate with some classic Styx on Nation Rocks!

moments.title: Nuno Bettencourt turns 60
moments.blurb: Nuno Bettencourt, the acclaimed guitarist for the rock band Extreme, celebrates his 60th birthday today, September 20.

angles.name: Extreme Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 60th Birthday to the incredible Nuno Bettencourt of Extreme! What's your favourite guitar solo by him?

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Turning the big 6-0 today is Nuno Bettencourt! Send your birthday wishes to the legendary Extreme guitarist.

moments.title: Thompson Twins' Alannah Currie is 69
moments.blurb: Alannah Currie, vocalist and saxophonist for the iconic 80s pop band Thompson Twins, celebrates her 69th birthday today, September 20.

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 69th Birthday to Alannah Currie of the Thompson Twins! Relive the 80s with classics like 'Hold Me Now'!

angles.name: Birthday Wishes
angles.copy: Sending birthday love to Alannah Currie! The Thompson Twins star is 69 today. What's your favourite hit from the band?

moments.title: Bruce Springsteen turns 77
moments.blurb: The legendary 'Boss' of rock and roll, Bruce Springsteen, celebrates his 77th birthday on Wednesday, September 23.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Boss
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 77th Birthday to the one and only Bruce Springsteen this Wednesday! What's your go-to 'Boss' anthem?

angles.name: Springsteen's Day
angles.copy: Celebrate Bruce Springsteen's 77th birthday on Wednesday with a playlist of his greatest hits! Born to Run or Dancing in the Dark?

moments.title: Bryan Ferry celebrates 81st birthday
moments.blurb: Bryan Ferry, the iconic frontman of Roxy Music and a successful solo artist, turns 81 on Saturday, September 26.

angles.name: Roxy Music Legend
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the incomparable Bryan Ferry this Saturday! From Roxy Music to his solo career, a true musical innovator.

angles.name: Smooth Operator
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Bryan Ferry, turning 81 this Saturday! What's your favourite track from his incredible career?

moments.title: Great British Harvest Festival in Suffolk
moments.blurb: The Great British Harvest Festival, celebrating British food and farming heritage, takes place at St Edmundsbury Cathedral in Bury St Edmunds, Suffolk, on Saturday, September 26, 2026.

angles.name: Suffolk Harvest
angles.copy: Celebrate local produce at the Great British Harvest Festival this Saturday at St Edmundsbury Cathedral! A fantastic day out in Suffolk.

angles.name: Foodie Fun
angles.copy: Bury St Edmunds is hosting the Great British Harvest Festival this Saturday! Get ready for delicious food and a celebration of farming. Who's going?

moments.title: Tottenham Harvest Festival concludes
moments.blurb: The Tottenham Harvest Food & Makers Festival, a two-day event celebrating local food and crafts, concludes today, Sunday, September 20, at Downhills Park, London.

angles.name: Last Day Tottenham
angles.copy: Last chance today to experience the Tottenham Harvest Food & Makers Festival at Downhills Park! Support local artisans and enjoy great food.

angles.name: Community Spirit
angles.copy: The Tottenham Harvest Festival wraps up today! A fantastic weekend celebrating local talent and community spirit. Did you get to visit?
